apps.name: Galaxy Gridiron
apps.summary: A read-only fantasy football companion for Sleeper leagues.
description: Galaxy Gridiron is a read-only companion for Sleeper fantasy football leagues. It never changes anything in your leagues and needs no password: you type your own Sleeper username and it shows your teams.

It is an Expo / React Native (TypeScript) Android app, with an iPhone web-app (PWA) export that you add to your Home Screen from Safari. An optional Cloudflare Worker powers an AI chat, so the app itself never holds an AI key.

platformNotes.web: iPhone web app (PWA), added to the Home Screen from Safari.

apps.name: Swipe Clean
apps.summary: Swipe through your photos to decide what to keep and what to delete.
description: Swipe Clean helps you tidy a photo library one swipe at a time: keep or delete, with undo and streaks.

The Android app (Expo / React Native) sorts photos from the device library and uses the system trash and delete dialogs, through a small Kotlin module that talks to MediaStore. The Web version is a browser demo for Google Photos using the Picker API with a read-only scope; it runs in demo mode with generated placeholder photos until you add your own Google OAuth client ID.

platformNotes.web: Browser demo (Google Photos Picker, read-only); demo mode without your own OAuth client ID.

apps.name: Kanban Board
apps.summary: A shared, offline-tolerant Kanban board for two people, with a TV mode.
description: Kanban Board is a shared board for two people. A tiny Node.js server with no dependencies holds the board and pushes live updates to every open screen, so phones, computers and a wall TV all show the same cards within about a second.

If the server can't be reached, an open page keeps working and queues changes until it is back. A TV mode (?tv=1) gives big text and a clock for a wall display, and the repo includes install, kiosk and watchdog scripts for a Raspberry Pi. Requires Node.js 18 or newer.

platformNotes.web: Runs in any browser; self-hosted with a small Node.js server (Raspberry Pi scripts included).

apps.name: Cat Health Dashboard
apps.summary: A small web app for logging your pets' health, with a weight chart per pet.
description: Cat Health Dashboard is a small single-page web app for logging pet health: weight, food, water, litter box, behavior, symptoms, meds, vet visits and upcoming appointments, with a weight chart for each pet.

It installs as a web app on phones, caches data offline in the browser, and syncs between phones through a here.now Site Data collection that you set up with your own config. Pets are added in the app; no data lives in the repo.

platformNotes.web: Installable web app (PWA) for phones; needs your own sync config to share data between phones.
